name: typing-indicator
description: Three bouncing dots that hold a chat message slot while an assistant (or a person) is composing a reply

meta.name: TypingIndicator
meta.description: Three bouncing dots that hold a chat message slot while an assistant (or a person) is composing a reply

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name announced by the status region.

props.name: label
props.description: Alias of `ariaLabel` — the same invisible accessible name. Neither is deprecated.

whenToUse: Holding the place of an assistant reply between sending a prompt and the first token arriving
Showing that another participant in a conversation is composing a message
whenNotToUse: Naming what the AI is doing ("Searching…", "Generating…") or offering Stop — use AiStatus
Once text has started streaming — render the text; the dots mean nothing has arrived yet
Non-conversational loading — use Spinner or Skeleton

antiPatterns.bad: Keeping TypingIndicator below a reply that is already streaming
antiPatterns.good: Swap TypingIndicator for the message content when the first token arrives
antiPatterns.why: Two progress signals at once compete, and the status region would keep claiming nothing has been written

related.name: ChatBubble
related.reason: Rendered as the content of a pending assistant ChatBubble

related.name: AiStatus
related.reason: AiStatus names the phase (thinking / generating) and can offer a Stop button

related.name: Spinner
related.reason: Spinner suits loading outside a conversation

intent.a11yRationale: role="status" with an accessible name ("Assistant is typing") is announced once when the indicator mounts; the dots are aria-hidden. They bounce only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and otherwise rest as a static ellipsis; forced colours paint them CanvasText

content.tone: Name who is typing — "Assistant is typing", "Ada is typing"

flexibility.note: Keep the status name — the dots alone carry no meaning for assistive tech
